units.rawText: It was as if she was looking at walking garbage.

units.rawText: Don't get the wrong idea. I mean the other half of your neural cloud.

spans.text: Don't get the wrong idea. I mean the other half of your neural cloud.

units.rawText: What do you mean "can't be good"?

units.rawText: Oh, I don't know, the type that come with tackling people to the ground at will.

spans.text: Oh, I don't know, the type that come with tackling people to the ground at will.

units.rawText: Are you doubting my professionalism?

spans.text: Are you doubting my professionalism?

units.rawText: Seems like poor safety standards to me.

spans.text: Seems like poor safety standards to me.

units.rawText: Hmph. Doesn't the other me have the memories? If she remembers the mission objectives, she'd come looking for you.

units.rawText: I'm not sure how long exactly, but during that time, she wasn't able to find me—or rather, did not look for me.

units.rawText: I take it that you got along pretty well with "me" before?

units.rawText: Do you mind that a lot?

units.rawText: If it doesn't obstruct the mission, then I have no objections.

units.rawText: If you're going to look for the other neural segment, we have resources here at the Enigma Sector that may be of use.

units.displayText: Resources?
